author: James Findlater
title: Liverpool transfer news amid 'definite' Adam Wharton update as Curtis Jones open to move - NewsBreak
text:
By James Findlater ,
29 minutes ago The summer is quickly approaching, and Liverpool will have some serious work to do in the transfer window - even if another huge spending spree is unlikely.
With just three games to go, the Reds are still on course to qualify for the Champions League , which could prove crucial in landing any targets before the 2026/27 season gets underway.
After what has been a hugely disappointing season, there are plenty of areas for Arne Slot and the club to address, especially with big names like Mohamed Salah and Andy Robertson departing - and the latest reports suggest another could be heading out the exit door.

• John Henry made Man Utd promise before completing Liverpool deal - 'We're doing this'
Here is the Liverpool.com verdict on the transfer gossip to emerge around the Reds today.
Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) Liverpool is interested in Adam Wharton, although it’s not yet clear whether the Reds will make a move for the Crystal Palace midfielder this summer, according to David Lynch .
It’s claimed that Liverpool will make midfield signings this summer, and Lynch suggests that Wharton could be “near the top of the list”, given that “it’s still clear that they like him a lot.”
Although no guarantees are made over a potential approach, the 22-year-old is said to “definitely” be on the club’s radar.
Liverpool.com says: Wharton would be a good option for Liverpool to consider, and it is clear that it needs to bolster its midfield this summer after what has been a disappointing campaign from Alexis Mac Allister.
Of course, Palace will be well within its rights to hold out for big money, and Liverpool has been burned by the Eagles before with Marc Guehi . With Oliver Glasner on his way out though, Wharton might see this as the right time to move on, which could make things a little easier.
Curtis Jones (Liverpool) Curtis Jones is open to a move to Inter Milan, according to Fabrizio Romano . The Liverpool midfielder was linked with the newly-crowned Serie A champions in January , and it seems the interest from Italy has been maintained.
Romano claims that Jones has “shown complete openness” to Inter’s plans, and likes the idea of playing in Italy.
What’s more, contract talks with Liverpool are said to be on hold, which could push him closer to the exit door. Aston Villa and Tottenham have also been credited with an interest in the 25-year-old.
Liverpool.com says: Jones is in a tricky spot right now. He is down the pecking order in midfield, and if Liverpool is going to add to its engine room this summer, then his chances of playing are only going to get worse.
You can't blame him if he does want to look elsewhere for an opportunity. It's not a move that sits comfortably, given he has worked his way through the academy, but if he feels he needs to move on, it is probably in the Reds' best interests to strike a deal.
